hero.eyebrow: Open source · runs locally · English and Chinese

features.title: Nothing hidden behind a framework, nothing to take on trust

request.title: Full requests and responses
request.body: Open the request body, the model's answer and its usage, event by event. SDK-standardized data is labelled as such, never passed off as raw HTTP.

code.title: Real source, real line numbers
code.body: The code scene shows the Python that actually runs; "new in this lesson" is computed from the syntax tree.

lab.title: Controlled experiments
lab.body: A hypothesis, control arms and observation points, checked against your own runs.

route.title: From a native loop to many agents
route.body: Hand-write the loop, then add context, retrieval, frameworks, evaluation, MCP and multiple agents.

curriculum.title: {{count}} lessons in {{categories}} domains
curriculum.lead: Generated at build time from the course catalog in the repository. Pick a domain to see what is inside.

replays.title: Not a demo animation. A real run.
replays.lead: Each replay is a lesson recording exported by the platform. The page only reads the recorded events and plays them in order; it never calls a model or runs a tool.
replays.provider: {{provider}} through {{name}} {{version}}: SDK-standardized data, not raw HTTP
replays.tokensNote: Token counts are the usage the provider reported in its responses.
replays.approvals: The approval cards were answered by the person who recorded the run, from a terminal through the platform's API; the replay shows them read-only.
replays.more: Show the full execution record: event list, JSON inspector, context film and lab report
replays.answerPending: Shown once the replay reaches the answer event.
replays.localeNote: This is a {{run}}, shown as recorded, not translated.

start.title: A few commands on your own machine
start.lead: You need Python 3.12+, uv, Node.js 22.12+ and npm. Then open http://127.0.0.1:8765.
start.keys: Keys stay in the local backend, never in run records, logs or browser storage.
start.bind: The server binds to 127.0.0.1 only and is meant for one learner.
start.sandbox: The coding-agent lessons run commands the model writes. The runner is not an isolated sandbox; you approve every command.
start.windows: Windows: use npm.cmd and start with .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe run_web.py, or run start-web.ps1.

honesty.title: What has not been verified, we say so
honesty.embedding: embedding-retrieval and hybrid-retrieval need an Embedding provider and have not been run against a real model.
honesty.injection: The prompt-injection defenses have not been tested against a persuaded model.
honesty.sample: On 2026-10-21 each exercise was sampled once per language with claude-haiku-5-5; that is not a statistical result. The replays here are a few runs recorded that day.

cta.title: Start with lesson one
cta.lead: One model request. Then an agent loop you wrote yourself.
